double_occupancy_semantics.sourceTitle: Auckland Travel Cost - Average Price of a Vacation to Auckland: Food & Meal Budget, Daily & Weekly Expenses | BudgetYourTrip.com
double_occupancy_semantics.evidenceText: The exact Auckland destination page says the average price paid in Auckland for two people for a typical double-occupancy hotel room is $194 (NZ$334), while one person sharing a room averages $97 (NZ$167) per night; these costs are from reported traveler spending.
double_occupancy_semantics.occupancyEvidence: The average price paid in Auckland for two people for a typical double-occupancy hotel room is $194; one person sharing a room is $97 per night.
double_occupancy_semantics.referencePeriod: Destination travel-cost data page; travel cost data last updated June 12, 2026; page opened 2026-08-01.
